task: Post-hoc saliency explanation on synthetic time series

primary_metric.name: AUPRC
primary_metric.definition: Area under the precision-recall curve between ShapeX saliency scores and the ground-truth salient timestep mask over all MCC-E test examples.

reference_setting.model_and_method: ShapeX with Transformer black-box classifier on MCC-E

reduced_reproduction.objective: Train the complete ShapeX explainer for 10 epochs and compute AUPRC on all 2,000 MCC-E test examples.

pipeline_stages.name: Download ShapeX MCC-E data and classifier and apply audited release fixes
pipeline_stages.paper_role: Materialize the public MCC-E tensors and Transformer classifier, correct local paths, class count, and the released TRAIN/TEST mapping reversal, and record source hashes.

pipeline_stages.name: Train ShapeX and evaluate full MCC-E saliency
pipeline_stages.paper_role: Train the segmentation, matching, diversity, and shapelet-encoding pipeline, then compare generated saliency with every test ground-truth mask using AUPRC.

stage_budgets.rationale: All released MCC-E splits and the paper's fixed Transformer classifier are retained.
Only explainer epochs and repeated seeds are reduced; the complete ShapeX objective and test set remain.

feasibility.rationale: Every method-defining stage and the complete frozen target evaluation are retained; only the preregistered training, generation, seed, or optimization budget is reduced.

contract_amendment.effective_scope: new attempts and resource-failure reruns only
contract_amendment.reason: The original 16 GiB CPU-memory limit was below observed compliant reproduction demand; the largest observed peak was approximately 67.4 GiB.
contract_amendment.comparison_policy: Do not merge this attempt with a v4.2 attempt without retaining the contract release as an experimental condition.
